cohort: The study included 28 patients diagnosed with cervical cancer in pregnancy (CCIP) at one center between January 1st, 2013 and June 30th, 2023.
finding: Clinical outcomes for patients with CCIP appear comparable to those observed in non-pregnant patients in the general population, and delaying treatment for pregnancy preservation by an average of 16.4 weeks did not lead to observed disease progression.
mod_finding: Fetuses were delivered via cesarean section at an average gestational age of 36.3 weeks for patients who chose pregnancy preservation.
